regimens.dose_text: Recommended starting dosage is 50 mg orally twice daily (100 mg per day). Maintenance range: 25 mg twice daily to 100 mg twice daily (50 mg to 200 mg per day). Gradual dose escalation is not required at initiation.

refs.quote: BRIVIACT injection may be used when oral administration is temporarily not feasible [see Dosage and Administration (2.3) ]. BRIVIACT injection should be administered intravenously at the same dosage and same frequency as BRIVIACT tablets and oral solution. The clinical study experience with BRIVIACT injection is up to 4 consecutive days of treatment.

value.effect: Co-administration significantly decreases brivaracetam plasma concentrations due to hepatic CYP induction.
value.management: Increasing brivaracetam dosage up to double the maintenance dose is recommended in patients taking rifampin.

refs.quote: Rifampin: Because of decreased concentrations, increasing BRIVIACT dosage in patients on concomitant rifampin is recommended.

value.effect: Increases exposure to carbamazepine-epoxide active metabolite, potentially causing dizziness, diplopia, and ataxia.
value.management: If tolerability issues arise, consider reducing the carbamazepine dosage in patients on concomitant brivaracetam.

refs.quote: Carbamazepine: Because of increased exposure to carbamazepine metabolite, if tolerability issues arise, consider reducing carbamazepine dosage in patients on concomitant BRIVIACT.

value.effect: Phenytoin concentrations can increase, elevating risk of phenytoin intoxication.
value.management: Monitor phenytoin plasma levels when initiating or titrating brivaracetam.
